name: verdandi-locality0

validity_scope.certifies: the process-isolated same-apparatus speed of the blocked and Morton floor-tile layouts vs the DDA baseline on host DANIELDILLBERG for scene witness with identity tiles, 300 samples x 8 interleaved strips

forbidden_interpretations: input-to-photon latency, a present, a window, a compositor: none is in this number
the whole-render cost: this is emit only, over the frozen strips + frame the layouts share
any comparison to GAUNTLET-0's instrumented render absolute (a different apparatus)
the per-variant deltas as pure hardware-resource costs: they are process-isolated same-apparatus improvements, and cache/scheduling make sub-phase subtraction non-additive
instruction-level invariance as proven: only OUTPUT byte-identity is proven (locality0-equiv); the address-generation isolation is a best-effort of code structure
any other host, scene, tile set or resolution; absolute us are host-specific
that a layout is promoted by this record: promotion is the reader's, from the three exits and the locked table
reading: the floor-tile execution-format court on host DANIELDILLBERG, process-isolated and interleaved over 8 strips (medians). Whole-frame p99: DDA baseline 8185 us; blocked 7734 (1072 permille of DDA, index tax X 356 us), morton 8736 (927 permille, X 1040 us). EXIT 1 (blocked wins): blocked is byte-identical AND faster than the DDA baseline (1072 permille of it) and at least as fast as morton (927). Action for the reader: LOCK the 8x8 blocked layout. Per-band floor p99 (dda/var): blocked near 868/922, mid 1562/1626, far 1393/1635; morton near 818/960, mid 1568/1980, far 1529/1869. Byte-identity was proven first (locality0-equiv, non-vacuous). The accepted single-thread emit p99 7734 us is the sealed HARD BASELINE for GAUNTLET-2. Deltas are process-isolated same-apparatus improvements (medians, outliers absorbed), NOT hardware-resource costs and NEVER compared to GAUNTLET-0's instrumented render absolute
